<description>
Use CoinsViewOverlay to speed up ConnectBlock in TestBlockValidity. This also has the benefit of not inserting entries fetched from db into the main cache.

cs_main must be held for each place where the overlay is being used, and the reset guard ensures it will be reset for the next caller.
</description>

[2026-10-08] rc:4213588131 inline on src/validation.cpp by l0rinc (member):
These fetches happen before input validation, so the submitter doesn’t need PoW or valid signatures to trigger them. They can reference other people’s UTXOs, even repeating the same large-script UTXO across distinct transactions, and prefetching can allocate copies before validation rejects the attempted spends.
</new_statements>
